newsitem.title: CANADA: Chieftain plans record spending in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Chieftain plans record spending in 1997.

text.p: Chieftain International Inc said on Wednesday it approved exploration and development spending of US$75 million in 1997, up from an estimated US$62 million in 1996.
Chieftain said 80 percent of its 1997 budget would be spent on new exploration, development and acreage acquisitions in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, its main operating region.
During the rest of this year and in 1997, Chieftain expected to participate in 70 wells, 37 of which would be Gulf of Mexico exploration wells, it said.
The company attributed the increased budget to a strong inventory of exploration prospects on its 110 offshore federal leases and a recent strong recovery in natural gas prices.
Chieftain said its total output in 1997 was projected at 43 billion cubic feet of natural gas equivalent, up from an estimated 32 BCFE this year.
